text:
Nina: quick sync on the Trace Viewer filter strip — focus is compacting filters, export label clarity, and keyboard/a11y behavior. posted a compact mock: https://figma.com/file/compact123

Elliot: mock looks promising. idea: collapse overflow filters into a single "filters" affordance that expands inline (not full popover) to avoid layout shifts. show correlation-id and request-id as persistent pills.

Ravi: persistent pills are crucial for SRE flows. when collapsed, the expanded inline list needs copy/link actions for each filter. please make sure export respects those selections.

Tara: accessibility: treat the entire strip as a composite control. one tab lands in the strip, then arrow keys navigate pills. active pill should have aria-pressed state. use aria-live to announce number of active filters when users toggle.

Elliot: agreed on single tab entry. current prototype had each pill tabbable  breaks keyboard flow. also add visible focus ring for keyboard users and ensure hover and focus color contrast passes AA.

Omar: export copy: strongly prefer explicit wording. suggestion: "Export filtered sessions (CSV)" and include a short tooltip that lists active filters on hover. inline quick-export shown only when filters > 0.

Nina: decision so far: persistent pills for correlation/request IDs, collapse others into a "Filters (N)" inline expander. export CTA text: "Export filtered sessions (CSV)" and place in kebab with quick-export visible inline when N>0.

Tara: screen-reader copy: pill label should read like "Filter: correlation id, 0a1b2c". when the expander opens, announce "Filter list expanded" and focus the first item. include instructions in aria-describedby for the export modal: what will be exported and the active filter count.

Ravi: backend note: export endpoint should accept an array of filter objects and a boolean include_correlation. i'll confirm param names today. also: when copying a trace link it should include &corr=0a1b2c so the drilldown reproduces exactly.

Elliot: layout micro: the inline expander should animate height and not push the timeline by more than 8px. on mobile it becomes a full-width sheet. add a micro tag icon on stacktrace lines when a correlation id is attached so its scannable in long traces.

design-bot: snapshot saved: figma frame "trace-viewer/compact-filter-strip/v1".

Nina: next actions: Elliot to update micro interactions and keyboard flow; Tara to produce exact SR copy strings; Ravi to confirm export API fields; Omar to mock quick-export placement. i'll gather the copy and open a PR. thanks! :wave:
